<translate>
<!--T:2-->
The '''Future Saga''' is a short branch of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Sagas|story mode]] set in Future Trunks' ruined timeline: the Androids, Future Gohan and Imperfect Cell. It opens, together with the [[Special:MyLanguage/Buu Saga|Buu Saga]], once you complete every quest of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Android Saga|Android Saga]], and all of its quests take place on [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]].
</translate>

<translate>
<!--T:3-->
The Future Saga and the Buu Saga can be played in any order. No other saga needs the Future Saga to open.
</translate>

<translate>
